_note: The 'missing consumer' trap: a revised cut moves exactly the symbols of one edge (b -> a) so the primitive's own coverage rule is satisfied and the delta would COMPUTE — but a second importer c -> a shares one of those symbols ('helper') and additionally imports 'other', which the move does not cover. The bounded repair must not read that as success: its own coverage check (over the SAME ArchGuard graph data) finds the partially-covered edge and refuses to accept the round.
